33088-putnam-s-handy-law-book-for-the-la.creator: Albert Sidney Bolles, Ph.D., LL.D.
33088-putnam-s-handy-law-book-for-the-la.description: A book by Albert Sidney Bolles, Ph.D., LL.D.. =Explanation of Terms.=--At the outset the explanation of a few terms, often used, may be helpful to the reader. Among these are the terms statute and common law. Statute law or statutes mean the laws enacted by the state legislature and by the federal congress. Common law means the decisions made by the state and federal courts.

arxiv-1810-11557.title: The Duration of Optimal Stopping Problems
arxiv-1810-11557.creator: Simon Demerslabel=e1]simon.demers@vpd.ca
arxiv-1810-11557.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Simon Demerslabel=e1]simon.demers@vpd.ca. Optimal stopping problems give rise to random distributions describing how many applicants the decision-maker will sample or interview before choosing one, a quantity sometimes referred to as the search time or process duration. This research note surveys several variants of optimal stopping problems, extends earlier results in various directions, and shows how many interviews are expected to be conducted in various settings.

arxiv-2307-12464.title: Surface gravity from tidal acceleration
arxiv-2307-12464.creator: Pravin Kumar Dahal
arxiv-2307-12464.description: Abstract Surface gravity plays a pivotal role in the characterization of black holes and also in formulating the laws of black hole thermodynamics. Despite its significance, defining surface gravity in general spacetimes is a nontrivial task and thus has multiple definitions that lack equivalence in dynamical scenarios.

arxiv-2402-14958.title: EE3P: Event-based Estimation of Periodic Phenomena Properties
arxiv-2402-14958.creator: Jakub Kolář, Radim Špetlík, Jiří Matas
arxiv-2402-14958.description: Abstract We introduce a novel method for measuring properties of periodic phenomena with an event camera, a device asynchronously reporting brightness changes at independently operating pixels. The approach assumes that for fast periodic phenomena, in any spatial window where it occurs, a very similar set of events is generated at the time difference corresponding to the frequency of the motion.

arxiv-2406-02391.title: Demonstration of Erasure Conversion in a Molecular Tweezer Array
arxiv-2406-02391.creator: Connor M. Holland, Yukai Lu, Samuel J. Li, Callum L. Welsh, Lawrence W. Cheuk
arxiv-2406-02391.description: Abstract Programmable optical tweezer arrays of molecules are an emerging platform for quantum simulation and quantum information science. For these applications, reducing and mitigating errors that arise during initial state preparation and subsequent evolution remain major challenges. In this paper, we present work on site-resolved detection of internal state errors and quantum erasures, which are qubit errors with known locations.

arxiv-2411-12699.title: Large non-Gaussianities corresponding to first-order phase transitions during inflation
arxiv-2411-12699.creator: Haipeng An, Qi Chen, Yuhang Li, Yuan Yin
arxiv-2411-12699.description: Abstract In this study, we explore the back reaction of phase transitions in the spectator sector on the inflaton field during slow-roll inflation. Due to the significant excursion of the inflaton field, these phase transitions are likely to occur and can induce substantial non-Gaussian correlations in the curvature perturbation.

arxiv-2507-20027.title: Binaural Localization Model for Speech in Noise
arxiv-2507-20027.description: Abstract Binaural acoustic source localization is important to human listeners for spatial awareness, communication and safety. In this paper, an end-to-end binaural localization model for speech in noise is presented. A lightweight convolutional recurrent network that localizes sound in the frontal azimuthal plane for noisy reverberant binaural signals is introduced.

arxiv-2512-10884.title: ENTCALC: Toolkit for calculating geometric entanglement in multipartite quantum systems
arxiv-2512-10884.creator: Piotr Masajada, Aby Philip, Alexander Streltsov
arxiv-2512-10884.description: Abstract We present entcalc , a Python and MATLAB package for estimating the geometric entanglement of multipartite quantum states. The package operates as follows: given a multipartite quantum state as input, it outputs an estimate of its geometric entanglement. For pure states, it computes the geometric entanglement together with an estimation error.

pmc-11535025.title: AI based predictive acceptability model for effective vaccine delivery in healthcare systems
pmc-11535025.creator: Muhammad Shuaib Qureshi, Muhammad Bilal Qureshi, Urooj Iqrar, Ali Raza, Yazeed Yasin Ghadi, Nisreen Innab, Masoud Alajmi, Ayman Qahmash
pmc-11535025.description: Vaccine acceptance is a crucial component of a viable immunization program in healthcare system, yet the disparities in new and existing vaccination adoption rates prevail across regions. Disparities in the rate of vaccine acceptance result in low immunization coverage and slow uptake of newly introduced vaccines.

pmc-11591760.title: Stress-Induced Ultrasonic Vocalization in Laboratory Rats and Mice: A Scoping Review
pmc-11591760.creator: Anumitha Venkatraman, Michelle Bretl, Se-in Kim, Leslie Christensen, Cynthia A Kelm-Nelson, Michelle R Ciucci, Susan L Thibeault, Hiroyuki Arakawa
pmc-11591760.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Introduction: Ultrasonic vocalization (USV) can indicate affective states—including psychosocial stress—in mice and rats. However, stress-induced USV changes could be confounded by laboratory experimental variables such as the type of behavioral stress paradigm, the elicitation method, rodent strain, etc. We sought to provide a review of the current literature to delineate how psychosocial stress-altered rodent USVs may be affected by factors of age, sex, strain, species, elicitation paradigm, and stressor.

pmc-11599311.title: Deep learning-aided respiratory motion compensation in PET/CT: addressing motion induced resolution loss, attenuation correction artifacts and PET-CT misalignment
pmc-11599311.creator: Yihuan Lu, Fei Kang, Duo Zhang, Yue Li, Hao Liu, Chen Sun, Hao Zeng, Lei Shi, Yumo Zhao, Jing Wang
pmc-11599311.description: PurposeRespiratory motion (RM) significantly impacts image quality in thoracoabdominal PET/CT imaging. This study introduces a unified data-driven respiratory motion correction (uRMC) method, utilizing deep learning neural networks, to solve all the major issues caused by RM, i.e., PET resolution loss, attenuation correction artifacts, and PET-CT misalignment.

pmc-11693275.title: A MOBILE CLINIC STUDY ON BRAIN HEALTH IN OLDER ADULTS IN A RURAL, SOCIOECONOMICALLY DISADVANTAGED COUNTY
pmc-11693275.creator: Marianne Chanti-Ketterl, Jennifer Jones-Locklear, Jada Brooks, Cierra Williams, Misty Bullard, Keenya Locklear, Scott Davis, Heather Whitson
pmc-11693275.description: ObjectiveThis collaborative pilot project assessed the feasibility of enrolling 50 older adults from underrepresented populations in Robeson County, North Carolina (NC), considered a racially diverse and socioeconomically disadvantaged area. MethodsThe study protocol, adapted from the Alzheimer’s Gut Microbiome Project, was modified to fit local cultural contexts with input from community and local academic partners.

pmc-11713298.title: Unmet ADL/IADL Needs among Veterans with Dementia: An Analysis of the HERO CARE Multi‐site Survey
pmc-11713298.creator: Marianne E Desir, Richard A Munoz, Jared Hansen, Fei Tang, Stuti Dang
pmc-11713298.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundReceiving sufficient assistance with ADLs/IADLs can support dementia patients’ physical and psychosocial health, as well as aging in place. The Department of Veterans Affairs has prioritized supporting Veterans in aging at place a home when this is their preference.

pmc-12608131.title: Extractive Electrospray Ionization Mass Spectrometry for Rapid Analysis of Organic and Inorganic Selenium in Honey
pmc-12608131.creator: Xinrui Zhang, Yuqi Qiu, Huiyu Xing, Feixiang Yang, Peng Zeng, Hao Fan, Huanwen Chen, Xiaowei Fang
pmc-12608131.description: Selenium, a crucial trace element for human health, plays a vital role in maintaining well-being. Its insufficiency can cause various diseases, highlighting the need for adequate selenium intake in daily diets. Honey, containing diverse selenium compounds, serves as a beneficial selenium supplement.

pmc-12642205.title: Investigating the attitudinal and behavioral consequences of work-life balance considering the mediating role of psychological contract violation among english language teachers
pmc-12642205.creator: Eesa Niazi, Ali Arabmofrad, Ramin Bagheri, Amir Hassan Shamsabadi
pmc-12642205.description: BackgroundThis study investigates the attitudinal and behavioral consequences of Work-Life Balance (WLB) among teachers, focusing on the mediating role of Psychological Contract Violation (PCV).MethodsAn applied, descriptive-correlational survey design was employed. The target population included all English language teachers in Golestan Province (N = 598), from which a simple random sample of 234 was selected.

pmc-12644597.title: AI-based forecasting of groundwater corrosion and scaling indices in semi-arid regions using 25-year data analysis
pmc-12644597.creator: Ali Gorjizade, Abbas Parsaie
pmc-12644597.description: Assessing water corrosivity indices is vital for sustainable management, since it damages infrastructure, increase costs, and threaten public health. In this study, the corrosive and scaling behavior of groundwater was modeled and predicted using, Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), Support Vector Machines (SVM), Multivariate Adaptive Regression Splines (MARS), and Random Forest (RF).

pmc-12722507.title: Complications during lumbar selective nerve root block: a scoping review
pmc-12722507.creator: Anna Frøbert Welinder, David Kocemba, Viktor Hartmann Kuang, Mikkel Mylius Rasmussen
pmc-12722507.description: IntroductionSelective Nerve Root Block (SNRB) is widely used for managing radicular pain, serving both therapeutic and diagnostic purposes. A complete list of all reported complications associated with SNRB has never been reported.AimTo map the existing evidence on complications associated with lumbar SNRB.

pmc-12973482.title: Matching Patients With Cell Surface–Targeted Clinical Trials Using Large Language Models
pmc-12973482.creator: S. Carson Callahan, Matthew R. Chrostek, Nicholas Rydzewski, Matthew Bootsma, Kyle T. Helzer, Hamza Bakhtiar, Zachary S. Morris, David Kosoff, Joshua M. Lang, Vincent T. Ma, Marina Sharifi, Shuang G. Zhao
pmc-12973482.description: PURPOSECell surface–targeted therapies (CSTs) are a rapidly expanding class of cancer treatments with high specificity and reduced toxicity. Matching patients who express specific targets to CST clinical trials remains challenging because of complex eligibility criteria, diverse targets, and the absence of centralized, up-to-date trial databases. These gaps limit patient access and contribute to poor trial accrual.

pmc-13109675.title: Cu and SnO2‐Modified Carbon Felt for Electroenzymatic CO2 Upcycling
pmc-13109675.creator: Diego Maureira, Lorena Wilson, Hilmar Guzmán, Tonia Tommasi, Debora Fino, Simelys Hernández, Carminna Ottone
pmc-13109675.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study reports scalable bioelectrodes for sustainable CO2‐to‐formate conversion that integrate on‐electrode cofactor regeneration with enzyme immobilization. Carbon felt (CF) supports were coated with copper (Cu) or tin oxide (SnO2) nanoparticles, allowing for reproducible and straightforward fabrication. Electrochemical characterization revealed that Cu‐modified electrodes (CF–NpCu) outperformed SnO2‐modified ones (CF‐NpSnO2) in NADH regeneration, achieving nearly double the faradaic efficiency (FE) toward formate and conversion yield.

pmc-13187277.title: Codon usage patterns and phylogenetic analysis of chloroplast genomes reveal evolutionary insights into Asphodelaceae species
pmc-13187277.creator: Kun Zhang, Ken Li, Jiaying Feng, Wanying Liu, Jiayin Feng, Weiqiang Fan, Xiaofei Shan
pmc-13187277.description: The phenomenon of codon usage bias (CUB) is prevalent across various genomes and offers critical insights into the molecular genetic evolution of organisms, as well as their adaptive strategies. Comparative analyses of CUB in chloroplast (cp.) genomes further deepen our understanding of the intricate phylogenetic relationships across taxonomic groups.

pmc-13261324.title: mHealth for chronic disease management: effects on adherence in Ghanaian patients with diabetes and hypertension
pmc-13261324.creator: Pearl Aovare, Felix P Chilunga, Amos Laar, Nicolas Moens, Eric P Moll van Charante, Charles Agyemang
pmc-13261324.description: BackgroundMedication non-adherence remains a major barrier to effective chronic disease management, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. In Ghana, limited access to continuous care and patient engagement tools contributes to poor adherence among individuals living with type 2 diabetes and hypertension. Mobile health interventions, including smartphone applications, may offer scalable solutions to support long-term medication use and self-management.

uslaw-usc-t42-s1982.title: 42 U.S.C. § 1982 — Property rights of citizens
uslaw-usc-t42-s1982.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s1982.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 21 (Civil Rights); Subchapter I (Generally). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. All citizens of the United States shall have the same right, in every State and Territory, as is enjoyed by white citizens thereof to inherit, purchase, lease, sell, hold, and convey real and personal property.
